prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production texture atlas for four admin dashboard panels.
Primary request: Generate an original luxury glossy glass material texture inspired by the attached dashboard's material treatment, not its interface. Exact layout: a landscape 1536x1024 image divided edge-to-edge into FOUR EQUAL VERTICAL STRIPS of 384x1024, no gaps and no outside margins. Strip 1: rich raspberry magenta smoked glass, bright diffused edge highlights with deep burgundy central negative space. Strip 2: black graphite liquid glass with soft silver reflections at top and bottom, dark central negative space. Strip 3: electric cobalt blue glass with cyan upper edge and violet lower glow, dark blue central negative space. Strip 4: vertically ribbed silver smoked glass with frosted reflections, dark charcoal central negative space. Front-facing flat textures, no perspective, no card shapes: the UI itself supplies rounded clipping. Smooth luxurious optical material, subtle grain, luminous but readable as backgrounds. Keep upper third and central areas dark enough for white data text.
Input image: reference for glass material and palette only.
Constraints: absolutely NO text, digits, logos, icons, UI, charts, buttons, people, hardware, borders or watermarks. Four independent equally wide full-height flat material swatches.
